High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4000 of 2023
Applicant :- Nanhu
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar Shukla,Shailendra Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
Heard Mr. Shailendra Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Hari Shankar Maurya, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 883 of 2022, under Section 376 I.P.C. and Section 5(m), 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Kotwali Nanpara, District Bahraich.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 12.12.2022 alleging that the applicant raped the informant's daughter aged about ten years on 11.12.2022 at about 4.30 p.m.
Although, in the statement of the informant and that of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. they supported the first information report's allegations and the victim elaborately described the incident and in the statement of the victim given before the doctor who has conducted her medico legal examination, but in her medico legal examination report no external injury was seen.
No abnormality was reported in the hymen and in the pathological examination report no live or dead spermatozoa or gonococci was seen.

It is significant to note that it is mentioned in the medico legal examination report that the victim had not changed her undergarments and had not washed Nanhu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105528385/
1 the same and she had not taken bath prior to her medico legal examination.
In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case, he has no criminal history.

entities.text: Nanhu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the allegations in the first information report are not supported by the medico legal examination report of the victim coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 12.12.2022 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am satisfied that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case crime.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Ram.
